title: Very Simple Staff Chat
description: This is a minecraft plugin that adds staff chat.
body:
# __Very Simple Staff Chat__
**Very Simple Staff Chat** is a minecraft plugin that adds a simplified staff chat to your server.

## Commands
**/vssc chat** - **Switches staff chat on or off**
**/vssc chat <player>** - **Switches a target's staff chat on or off.**

## Permissions
**vssc.chat** - **Required to turn staff chat on or off.**

**vssc.admin** - **Required to turn a target's staff chat on or off.**
